name: BTC Trust
description: Family Bitcoin trust workspace: a read-only view of your node's mainnet chain (dashboard, daily block log, economy timeline) plus multisig wallets, an encrypted trust vault and end-to-end encrypted trustee messaging.

SPLIT MODE: your node is only ever asked read-only questions (an allowlist of 15 RPC methods such as getblockchaininfo and getblock), enforced in the app and again by bitcoind's rpcwhitelist for a dedicated 'btctrust' RPC user.
WALLETS ARE TEST-ONLY: wallets, PSBTs, the vault and messaging run on a separate bundled REGTEST (or signet) node with worthless test coins. Never send real bitcoin to addresses shown in this app.

app_page_content.heading: First run
content: Click Open, then enter the setup token shown below under App Default Credentials and choose an app passphrase (12+ characters). After that the token is retired and the passphrase is all you need.
The app passphrase protects the whole app. Trust-vault documents and trustee messaging keys have their own separate passphrases.

app_page_content.heading: What touches your node
content: Only read-only RPC calls, through the dedicated 'btctrust' RPC user that the installer added with rpcwhitelist (see docs/mynode-install.md). Wallet, send, sign, import and mining calls are refused by the app and by bitcoind.
Wallet features use a separate bundled regtest node. They are for learning and testing only: test coins have no value.
